title: Injection on mapped parameters
summary: Detect SQLi/SSTI/command injection via disciplined canaries then targeted escalation.
steps: Rank params from map (id, q, sort, template, host, cmd-like names).
Send benign baseline then one canary family at a time (SQLi boolean/time, SSTI {{7*7}}, cmd separators).
compare_requests baseline vs mutant for body/timing differentials.
Escalate with sqlmap/xsstrike only on anomalous params — never blind spray all params.
On PASS: concrete param + differential or data extraction evidence.
kill_signals: No anomalous differentials after ranked probes
